name: Alan Nunnelee
bio: A Representative from Mississippi; born in Tupelo, Lee County, Miss., October 9, 1958; B.S., Mississippi State University, Mississippi State, Miss., 1980; business owner; member of the Mississippi state senate, 1995-2010; elected as a Republican to the One Hundred Twelfth and to the two succeeding Congresses; served until his death on February 6, 2015 (January 3, 2011-February 6, 2015); died on February 6, 2015, in Tupelo, Miss.
